config.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.

design.assignment: alternate monthly purchase index; fixed for life
design.execution: all eligible own-variant signals while flat; one MNQ per account
design.acquisition: one funded PA monthly, uncapped, externally financed, no extra replacements
design.terminal: one firm-permitted request; voluntary cushion released
design.neutrality: exact per-account accepted trade keys and killing trade
